description: Free and open-source Windows PDF editor with its embedded portable payload extracted and verified directly inside Scoop, plus OCR, annotation, text editing, redaction, signing, forms, comparison and conversion.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'KillerPDF portable launcher is missing.' }
if ($null -eq $resource) { throw 'The official KillerPDF payload resource was not found.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payloadManifestPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'KillerPDF payload.manifest is missing.' }
if ($fields.Count -ne 3 -or $fields[0] -notmatch '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$' -or $fields[1] -notmatch '^[0-9]+$') { throw 'KillerPDF payload manifest contains an invalid entry.' }
if ([System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($relative) -or ($relative -split '\\' | Where-Object { $_ -in @('', '.', '..') })) { throw 'KillerPDF payload contains an unsafe path.' }

if (-not $file.StartsWith($root, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file -PathType Leaf)) { throw "KillerPDF payload file is missing or unsafe: $relative" }
if ($info.Length -ne [long]$fields[1]) { throw "KillerPDF payload file size mismatch: $relative" }
if ($checked -eq 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $stage 'KillerPDF.App.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'KillerPDF application payload is incomplete.' }
notes: The manifest extracts and verifies every file in the official embedded payload, then runs KillerPDF.App.exe directly from the Scoop version directory instead of using the vendor launcher's temporary AppData extraction.
User settings and data are persisted in KillerPDF-Data. Use 'scoop update killerpdf' to update the Scoop-managed copy.
